headline: A senior Iranian official has threatened to hit cables, data centers and AI facilities in the region if heavy fighting in the war with the United States breaks out again.
score_reason: Pool 6 kept: the remarks were reported on 11 Oct 2026 and the roundup supports the headline; it is a conditional threat relayed through Iranian state media, not an attack, and no site is named.
importance_line: People and businesses in the region who depend on those cables and data centers would be affected first if the threat were carried out, then governments and the companies that run the sites, but it is a conditional threat reported through Iran's state news agency, it names no site, and talks to end the war are still going on through mediators.
summary: Fortune reports, in a Middle East roundup whose identical text PBS News also published and which cites Iran's state news agency IRNA, that Mohsen Rezaei, a former Revolutionary Guard commander described as head of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, called Washington's latest reply to a proposal to end the war "insufficient" and threatened "cables, data centers, AI facilities and other sites in the region" if heavy fighting resumes. The threat is conditional and names no site; it comes as talks to end the war and fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz, the shipping route out of the Gulf, limp along after a June agreement between the two countries collapsed within days, and more ships have been attacked in the strait since Iran's proposal at the UN last month was rejected.
notes: Read in full (Fortune fulltext copy). The same text is on PBS News (https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/iran-calls-latest-u-s-proposal-to-end-war-insufficient-as-netanyahus-corruption-trial-resumes, byline Michael D. Regan); Fortune's copy shows no credit and the original could not be settled, so both are named in the source line. Rezaei's words come from IRNA via the roundup. The roundup is headed 'Saturday' but includes Sunday events; WANA datelines the remarks Oct 11, so the pool score of 6 is kept (regional find) and the item is marked NEW.
